fusions.name: Mauling Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage, knocking each enemy 3 tiles back and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven to the Hilt
fusions.desc: Puts your full weight behind the blade for 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Bristling Embrace
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood on the Pelt
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
